summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of 3D indigenous food heritage map. Backend already passed 18/18 tests in previous iteration (skipped as instructed). Tested loading screen, intro overlay, Start Exploring button, map interface, music player, AI Snapshot with Q&A generation, Help dialog, About dialog with credits, and font verification. Main limitation: MapLibre GL renders markers on canvas (not DOM), preventing automated marker click testing, but visual verification confirms all UI elements render correctly.

backend_issues.note: Backend testing skipped as instructed - backend already passed 18/18 tests in iteration_2

integration_issues.issue: Markers are rendered on HTML5 Canvas via MapLibre GL, not as DOM elements. Automated testing tools (Playwright) cannot interact with canvas-rendered elements using standard selectors. This is a testing limitation, not a functional bug.
integration_issues.impact: Could not automate: marker click → place card → food entry → detail drawer → talking tour flow
integration_issues.visual_verification: Screenshots confirm markers are visible, glowing, and properly positioned on map
integration_issues.fix_priority: LOW - This is expected behavior for canvas-based map libraries. Manual testing or specialized canvas testing tools would be needed.
integration_issues.workaround: Visual verification via screenshots confirms UI renders correctly

integration_issues.issue: Tab click registered but content did not switch from 'The Experience' to 'Credits & Licensing' in automated test. May be a timing/animation issue or tab state management.
integration_issues.impact: Could not verify copyright and music credits via automation
integration_issues.code_verification: Reviewed AboutDialog.jsx code - all copyright info and music credits are correctly implemented in the component
integration_issues.fix_priority: MEDIUM - Tab switching should work reliably

additional_notes.critical_fix_from_last_iteration: VERIFIED: 'Start Exploring' button no longer has float-slow transform animation - only box-shadow pulses via .pulse-glow animation. Button is now a stable click target.
